name: NexaBoard – Discussion Forum & Community
author: nexaboard

sections.description:
NexaBoard adds a discussion forum and community area to WordPress. It includes forum organization, topics and replies, member profiles, moderation tools, read tracking, follows, bookmarks, attachments and configurable forum pages.

The core plugin does not require paid code or a license to use its included features. Optional extensions can be installed separately as normal WordPress plugins.

Main features:

  • Forum/category structure with up to three levels.
  • Topics, replies, pagination and forum statistics.
  • Read/unread forum and topic tracking for signed-in members.
  • Topic follow and saved-topic/bookmark features.
  • Member profiles with avatar, signature and social links.
  • Frontend login, registration and lost-password shortcodes/forms.
  • Moderation tools for sticky, global sticky, lock, move, merge and split actions.
  • Post reporting and moderator/admin report management.
  • Frontend attachments with validation and limits.
  • Internal forum search and member mention suggestions.
  • Responsive frontend and admin interfaces.
  • Template overrides from a theme or child theme.
  • Import tools for bbPress, BuddyPress Forum and wpForo Forum.
  • Export/import tools for moving NexaBoard forum data between WordPress sites.

Shortcodes

  • [nexaboard_forum] — displays the forum interface.
  • [nexaboard_profile] — displays the member profile interface.

Template overrides

Do not edit template files inside the plugin if you want your changes to survive plugin updates.

Copy a template from:

/wp-content/plugins/nexaboard-discussion-forum-community/templates/

to the corresponding path in your theme or child theme:

/wp-content/themes/your-theme/nexaboard/

Example:

templates/forum/topic.php

becomes:

/wp-content/themes/your-theme/nexaboard/forum/topic.php<h3>Forum icons</h3>

The default read/unread forum icons are stored in:

/wp-content/plugins/nexaboard-discussion-forum-community/assets/images/
  • forum-read.svg
  • forum-unread.svg

Privacy and security

NexaBoard validates state-changing browser requests with WordPress nonces and applies capability/authorization checks where an action is restricted. User-supplied values are validated or sanitized before use. Email-verification links use expiring, one-time verification tokens rather than logged-in WordPress nonces.

Site administrators remain responsible for configuring WordPress user access, backups, email delivery and server upload limits appropriately for their site.

Extensions

Optional NexaBoard extensions are installed as separate WordPress plugins. NexaBoard core does not write extension PHP code into its own plugin directory and does not require a paid license to use the features included in core.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress.org directory when available.
  2. Activate NexaBoard.
  3. Open NexaBoard > Forums to create the forum structure.
  4. Open NexaBoard > Settings to review the pages used by the forum and member profile shortcodes.
  5. Add the NexaBoard forum/profile shortcodes to pages if you prefer to create those pages manually.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the forum templates?

Yes. Copy the template you want to change into the matching nexaboard/ path in your theme or child theme as described above.

Does NexaBoard support moderators?

Yes. Administrators can assign global or forum-specific moderator permissions from the NexaBoard admin area.

Can I import an existing forum?

NexaBoard includes import tools for bbPress, BuddyPress Forum and wpForo Forum. Back up the database before importing content.

Are optional extensions required?

No. The features included in NexaBoard core work without installing paid extensions or entering a license key.

1.0.1

  • Fixed the responsive forum toolbar layout so descriptions are not squeezed on mobile screens.
  • Refreshed the forum stylesheet cache when the CSS file changes.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release of NexaBoard – Discussion Forum & Community.
  • Includes forum/topic/reply management, member profiles, moderation, read tracking, follows, saved topics, attachments, imports and data transfer tools.
  • Added nonce and permission checks before processing state-changing admin, AJAX and frontend requests.
